title: Partial closed data, evaluation and functorial permitted-pair transport
statement: Use the tensor and permitted internal-Hom domains of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For a preadditive category $C$, a tensor bifunctor $T:C\times C\to C$, an object predicate $J$ on $C^{op}\times C$ and $H:J\to C$, partial closed data consists of additive equivalences $\operatorname{Hom}(T(L,M),N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(L,H(M,N))$ for all $L$ and permitted pairs $(M,N)$, natural in $L$: transposing $T(f,1)\,b$ gives $f$ followed by the transpose of $b$. Its evaluation $T(H(M,N),M)\to N$ is the inverse transpose of the identity. For $F:C\to D$ and predicates $J,K$ with $K((F^{op}\times F)(P))$ for each $P\in J$, define the permitted-pair functor as the restriction of $F^{op}\times F$, retaining the given witnesses.
